map.输入任意两个已知量，自动计算第三个量。公式：ρ = m / V。: Input any two of density, mass and volume to compute the third with ρ = m/V, with a preset table of common material densities.
map.密度会随温度和压力变化，参考值为常温常压下典型值。: Density varies with temperature and pressure; reference values are typical at normal temperature and pressure.
map.请确保至少输入两个有效数值，或选择一个物质并输入一个量。: Ensure at least two valid numbers, or select a material and enter one quantity.
map.用称重加排水法测不规则固体的密度。: Measure irregular-solid density by weighing and water displacement.
map.m=100 g、V=50 cm³ → ρ=2 g/cm³（如花岗岩）。: m=100 g, V=50 cm³ → ρ=2 g/cm³ (e.g. granite).
map.会。含孔洞或空腔会使表观密度偏低，需先排除封闭空隙。: Yes. Holes or cavities lower the apparent density; exclude closed voids first.
map.密度是物质单位体积的质量，公式为 ρ = m / V。本工具支持密度、质量、体积: Density is the mass per unit volume, formula ρ = m / V. This tool supports mutual conversion among density, mass and volume, with a reference of common material densities.
map.密度 ρ = 质量 m ÷ 体积 V，三量知二求一：缺 ρ 时 ρ = m ÷: Density ρ = mass m ÷ volume V; given any two of the three, solve the third: without ρ, ρ = m ÷ V (requires V >0); without m, m = ρ × V; without V, V = m ÷ ρ (requires ρ >0); linked conversions g/cm³ = ρ ÷ 1000, L = V × 1000. Validation: fewer than 2 valid inputs (not NaN and ≥0) prompts "Please enter at least two valid values"; filling all three prompts "Please leave at least one unknown empty so it can be calculated." Grading: only one unknown is solved at a time, and in every branch the identity ρ × V = m holds.
